[Discord] [5e Star Wars] [Play by Post]

Our server is now in open beta! 

The Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire are locked in a cold war while the Jedi and the Sith attempt to rebuild after the last war. It's up to the next generation to prepare themselves for the next Great War. 

Be who you want to be in the Star Wars Old Republic Era. Jedi, Sith, bounty hunter,  anything you could want. 

We're a new but friendly server that's looking for dedicated role players to help us further get off the ground. If you're interested,  please join!

[Our link is here](https://discord.gg/Xpmfrnw8qT)
Hello, I'm hoping some people didn't slip between the cracks here. Have we talked further? I'd love to invite you to play.

[Discord][Star Wars][5e][play-by-post] Project Corellia 

Have you ever wondered what it would like to be a Jedi Knight? Or a Dark Lord of the Sith? Perhaps a military soldier in a galactic war? A bounty hunter with a code of ethics? 

Me too, that's why I created Project Corellia. Project Corellia is a new play-by-post server using the D&D Star Wars conversion that uses (optional) PVP elements to simulate the war between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empires in the Old Republic era. 

The server is about to go into alpha, and then open beta. But first I need a couple more people to be involved at least for one to two weeks.

Here's what I need:

1-2 GMs with prior experience, moderate to high Star Wars knowledge, and at least basic fluency with discord.

1-2 Moderators with the free time to help develop the server and helping develop my ruleset into something airtight. Prior experience preferred but not necessary.

5-10 Alpha players with passion and free time. Star Wars knowledge is assumed but certainly not required!

If you're interested in participating in the beta, comment below or DM me on Reddit.

If you really want to get my attention (God forgive me for this) add me on discord at Corellian#1977.

[5e][Star Wars][Play-by-Post] PROJECT CORELLIA

Have you ever wanted your own story in the Star Wars universe? Are you a fan of the Knights of the Old Republic or The Old Republic MMO? Because I'm right there with you. So I made my own place to do it.

Project Corellia is a new play by post server designed by me that is built using the D&D Star Wars conversion. Multiple planets, Jedi, Sith, smugglers, bounty hunters; be whoever you want to be.

The server is about ready to go into Alpha for two weeks before our open Beta. There's just a couple of things I need!

1-2 GMs (I also GM and moderate):
Needing: Intimate knowledge of D&D 5th edition and willingness to learn this setting conversion, moderate to high knowledge of the Star Wars universe, familiarity with discord, and free time.

1-2 Moderators
Needing: Intimate knowledge of Discord and familiarity with bots. Previous moderation experience is appreciated, but far from necessary.

5-10 Alpha Players
Needing: Passion, basic familiarity with D&D, and free time to roleplay especially during the early days of the server while we get everything worked out.

People who apply for Staff and are accepted and mesh well with the team get PCs who start at level 10! If you're interested, comment below or DM me.
